events.headline: QATAR SAYS ONLY NEGOTIATIONS CAN RESOLVE REGIONAL TENSIONS
events.detail: Qatar says diplomatic efforts are ongoing to de-escalate regional tensions and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: IRAN OFFERS US DEAL TO REOPEN HORMUZ WITHIN A WEEK
events.detail: Tehran says it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week if Washington accepts its peace plan, which Trump previously rejected Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: TWO SUPERTANKERS HIT MINES IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ – IRGC (VIDEO)
events.detail: Two oil supertankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, Iran’s IRGC has told RT Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: CONTAINER SHIP SINKS AFTER HITTING MINE IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ (VIDEOS)
events.detail: A container ship sank after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz as the US released footage of an attack on an alleged Iranian spy vessel Read Full Article at RT.com
